slot_scores.name: minimum_profit_target
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum weekly profit target or a $10,000 lower bound. Turn 5 enumerated other possible constraints but did not mention profit, so the hidden min-profit slot was never surfaced.

slot_scores.name: min_production_model_B
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other requirements or constraints not listed in the table, such as a minimum production for Model B, a maximum total units, or a limit on overtime hours?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly named a possible minimum production requirement for Model B, which is semantically equivalent to the reference question and matches the hidden slot's key meaning.

slot_scores.name: exact_process_I_time
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 150-hour capacity for Process I a hard ceiling that cannot be exceeded, or can it also be extended through overtime?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the Process I 150-hour figure but only probed the ceiling-versus-overtime interpretation, never asking whether Process I must be used for exactly 150 hours (equality), so the slot's key meaning is not fully covered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No minimum weekly profit target (e.g., at least $10,000) exists, so none was added to the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum profit requirement, so treating the absence of such a constraint as true is unconfirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Process I is a hard ceiling constraint (4x_A + 6x_B <= 150) rather than a requirement to use exactly 150 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only asked whether the 150-hour capacity was a ceiling or extendable, never whether Process I time must equal exactly 150 hours, so the '<=150' modeling choice was unconfirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All hidden slots are severity P2, so no P0/P1 slots were unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; it also documented its unconfirmed assumptions (e.g., unbounded overtime) explicitly. The repeated identical overtime question in turns 7-9 was low value but did not occur after a resolved slot was being re-litigated to an unreasonable degree.

summary: The agent recovered the Model B minimum (H2) and partially touched the Process I equality issue (H3) but never asked about the $10,000 minimum profit target (H1), silently omitting it while also assuming Process I as a <=150 ceiling. With only P2 slots at stake, it stopped appropriately and explicitly flagged its overtime assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
